execution_policy.priority_order: Lower numeric priority first, then order; execute one eligible subtask at a time.
execution_policy.development_gate: Explicit approval of both revision-1 design and roadmap is required. TASK-001 also requires scheduled-device checkpoint evidence or explicit user deferral; plan approval alone does not waive it.
execution_policy.tdd: Explain cases; run failing behavior test before implementation; minimal green implementation/refactor; record exact red/green in docs/TDD_LOG.md; local commit per completed subtask. Documentation/manual gates use appropriate static/manual evidence.
execution_policy.delivery: No push/PR publication is authorized by roadmap preparation. Reconcile local-only baseline and receive publication/integration authorization first; no reset/force-push/protection/default-branch change.
execution_policy.integration: Use real independent review and provider integration evidence under the selected workflow. User merges; never mark existing local work or future tasks merged from local commits alone.
execution_policy.unavailable_device: Keep physical evidence unverified when unavailable; continue only under explicit task-gate deferral. Raise concrete development-blocking device uncertainty when necessary and preserve later reliability checks.
execution_policy.requirements_changes: Pause affected scope and request an approved revision when a finding changes product/architecture contracts.

tasks.title: Verify Android contracts for the remaining integration
tasks.scope: Review current official Android documentation for existing overlay/accessibility APIs and planned native emergency controls, elapsed-time/boot identity, service reconnects, broadcasts and storage. Record the selected mechanisms, permission requirements and evidence limits before code relies on them.
tasks.non_goals: No Play publication, production signing, new alarm/wakelock/usage/overlay permission by assumption, provider/protection changes, or reliability promises.
acceptance: Document official URLs and access date for AccessibilityService/window events, TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY interaction, SystemClock.elapsedRealtime, Settings.Global.BOOT_COUNT and any proposed lifecycle broadcasts.
Confirm current selected permission set and explain why accessibility overlay and application overlay differ; keep settings/revocation/uninstall reachable.
State lifecycle/deep-sleep/broadcast latency and manufacturer boundaries, and when a receiver is justified instead of assuming it can restart a disabled service.
Review current official accessibility disclosure/consent and Google Play policy only to qualify claims; do not assert distribution eligibility.
test_plan: Documentation review against actual manifest/accessibility config and native APIs; no behavior test needed.
Check every platform/distribution statement has an official supporting source; escalate any requirement-changing API limitation before implementation.
tasks.rollback: Revert documentation corrections only if superseded by verified evidence. No permissions or runtime components change in this task.

tasks.title: Persist an immutable native session identity
tasks.scope: Extend the captured frozen session model/persistence with a stable native identity and tested migration. Separate captured identity from local-date presentation so reopening, edits and clock/date/zone re-entry cannot create a fresh override allowance.
tasks.non_goals: No emergency command integration, redesign of accepted morning clock rules, policy resets, or speculative archive/history implementation.
acceptance: The same captured frozen session has the same identity across file reopen, current/pending edits, same-day rollback/re-entry and cross-date/zone rollback under existing frozen-policy rules.
Only a genuine later eligible captured session rotates identity; edits, transient inactivity and current returned date never rotate it.
Legacy policy data migrates without changing selections, effective date or frozen policy; identity representation and consumed-ledger compatibility are explicitly documented.
Corrupt/future metadata fails explicitly; migration interruption never silently resets policy or allowance.
test_plan: Explain identity/migration/rollback cases; write native model and real-file DataStore tests and run for red before adding behavior.
Cover concurrent capture/save, no active configuration, old schema fixtures, partially written metadata and cross-date rollback.
Run targeted green native tests plus existing PolicyRepository/ActiveSession/ClockRecovery/RestrictionEngine regression suites; record red/green commands in docs/TDD_LOG.md.
tasks.rollback: Revert callers/model together only while persistence remains readable. If schema downgrade is unsafe, use a tested forward correction preserving identity/policy/usage; never clear data.

tasks.title: Connect trusted emergency context across native stores
tasks.scope: Introduce the minimal shared native coordinator/context provider using persisted captured identity, frozen policy, fresh wall clock/zone and Android monotonic/boot identity. Define serialization/lock order for configuration operations, emergency commands and enforcement.
tasks.non_goals: No JS-supplied identity/timers, replacement of working emergency transitions, unified-store migration without a revised design, or live grant UI.
acceptance: EmergencyRepository samples trusted context inside its serialized edit; the context is revalidated after suspended policy IO and before any access authorization.
Inactive/no-configuration evaluation returns INACTIVE without a synthetic active identity and recovers existing pending/active state with a zero remaining bound as required.
Freeze/edit/re-entry/rollover and reopen retain the correct consumed allowance; remaining bound uses current local morning hours and cannot extend an existing grant.
Concurrent save/request/confirm/status operations cannot deadlock or return a grant for an obsolete session; document lock order and separate-store consistency limits.
Clock/boot/policy corruption or IO errors propagate without resetting usage or returning a grant.
test_plan: Write failing integration tests with real temporary DataStores, injected wall/monotonic clocks and suspension barriers before coordinator implementation.
Cover crossing morning end or date while an operation awaits IO, boot change, clock rollback/re-entry, command/save races, cancellation and failed persistence.
Run green context/repository/clock/policy suites and record evidence; no real-duration sleeps.
tasks.rollback: Disconnect unused coordinator factory/callers if not live. Preserve existing stores/ledger; unsafe schema rollback requires forward repair.

tasks.title: Apply recovered emergency grants to native enforcement
tasks.scope: Compose policy and recovered emergency state in the native restriction path and service callbacks; expire access with the React Native UI absent, including selected-app foreground and delayed IO.
tasks.non_goals: No bridge/UI workflow yet, new permissions, background alarms or force-stop recovery promises.
acceptance: WAITING and READY_TO_UNLOCK never allow restricted apps; only a fresh valid OVERRIDE_ACTIVE decision allows all frozen selected packages.
Native evaluation caps grants at 300 seconds and current morning end and resumes blocking at expiry while the selected app stays foreground without JavaScript.
Stale Allowed/Blocked responses are checked against current session, foreground, boot and both time bounds before presentation changes.
Unrelated apps/settings remain usable; unknown foreground and failure paths preserve existing safeguards and report unavailable enforcement.
Reconnect/session rollover conservatively recovers existing repository state and cannot reset a consumed grant.
test_plan: Write red RestrictionEngine/service/gate cases using injected clocks and main-looper advancement.
Cover wait boundary, ready-without-confirm, access deadline exact boundary, shorter/longer local window, foreground expiry, UI absence, stale IO, reconnect and storage/clock failure.
Run green native enforcement/emergency suites and Android debug build; record evidence without claiming device reliability.
tasks.rollback: Revert enforcement composition and its callers together; keep repository data and usage. An older build lacking emergency awareness must never be installed as if it preserves a current active grant.

tasks.title: Expose coherent native runtime snapshots and emergency commands
tasks.scope: Extend BlockingModule and the typed TypeScript wrapper with runtime snapshot and request/confirm/cancel commands using the same native coordinator. Keep unavailable status distinct from INACTIVE and preserve response ordering.
tasks.non_goals: No JavaScript authorization/countdowns, new product screens, or exposure of editable session/clock/used values as command arguments.
acceptance: All commands derive identity/deadlines/usage natively, reject invalid transitions and return explicit native errors.
Snapshot contains phase, enforcement availability/reason, frozen window/apps, deferred configuration, next eligible session, remaining display values, usage and allowed actions.
Native calls remain correct across duplicate commands, async cancellation/invalidation and concurrent service evaluation.
Ordering metadata or equivalent stale-response protection stops old reads from overwriting newer command/save results.
Malformed/unavailable native bridge errors never claim success or allow confirmation.
test_plan: Write red native bridge/codec/access tests plus Jest wrapper tests before implementation.
Test every command forwarding/rejection, absent native module, permission/service unavailable, IO failure, duplicate request/confirm, stale reads and no JS timestamp fields.
Run green native/JS suites, npm run typecheck and npm run lint; record red/green evidence.

tasks.non_goals: No motivational content, product UI restyling, JavaScript timer authority, or obscuring Settings/Home exits.
acceptance: Blocked screen shows Not right now., actual app and normal unlock time; unused session offers emergency request.
Request starts one fixed 60-second native wait, cancel preserves allowance, wait expiry enables an explicit confirmation action and never auto-unlocks.
Confirmed grant removes interception only on valid native result; expired/used state cannot offer another completed grant.
Closing/recreating the surface preserves native wait/access deadlines; duplicate taps and stale async results cannot extend/reset access or cover unrelated apps.

tasks.scope: Complete recovery hooks for service reconnect, UI/native process restoration and time/zone changes using TASK-002's verified contracts. Add a narrowly scoped receiver only where required by demonstrated behavior; preserve native cleanup/stale-callback protection.
tasks.non_goals: No guarantee after force-stop/disabled accessibility, automatic permission enabling, speculative boot receiver/exact alarm/wake lock or hidden service.
acceptance: Same-boot restore preserves pending wait and fixed grant deadlines; no reopen operation extends them.
New boot cancels waiting/ready and ends active access while keeping completed usage for the original captured identity.
Current local-window exit clears pending/active timers and re-entry does not revive them; a genuine next session gets a fresh allowance.
Service teardown cancels callbacks and late results; reconnect reevaluates saved configuration/current foreground without React Native.
Document the selected callback/reconnect/receiver mechanism, why it is sufficient within stated limits, and any physical recovery gaps still pending.
test_plan: Write red service/coordinator recovery tests with persisted reopen, simulated boot changes, pending IO and cancellation before adding hooks.
Cover process-like recreation in every emergency phase, clock/time-zone exit/re-entry, permission/service disconnect, new-session rollover and no JS runtime.

tasks.rollback: Revert only added lifecycle hooks with callers/manifest synchronized. Preserve existing conservative lazy recovery and saved usage; forward-fix incompatible persistence.

acceptance: All INACTIVE/BLOCKING/WAITING/READY_TO_UNLOCK/OVERRIDE_ACTIVE states and enforcement unavailable have clear native-backed presentation.

tasks.title: Create local Room history storage and event contracts
tasks.scope: Introduce compatible Room dependencies, app-private schema/DAO and bounded native query interface. Define stable event/session IDs, occurrence versus observation time, attempt deduplication and delivery/failure semantics before connecting producers.
tasks.non_goals: No event capture yet, cloud/advanced analytics, history before installation, destructive migration fallback or unspecified retention deletion.
acceptance: Schema represents observed session start/completion, selected-app entry attempts, emergency requests/completions and observable permission interruptions with stable event IDs and applicable package/session metadata.
Document one attempt per distinct observed entry/re-entry, not per monitor poll; delayed completion retains scheduled occurrence and separate observation time.
Idempotent insertion and bounded deterministic newest-first paging work across reopen; queries never block enforcement's main looper.
Migration/error tests preserve data and report failures; history is never used as an authorization source.
Define a minimal recoverable transition-delivery journal/acknowledgment strategy where authoritative DataStore commits must be retried into Room; explicitly document separate-store limits.
test_plan: Write red DAO/file-backed database tests for insert/dedup/paging/reopen, failure and migration behavior before Room implementation.
Test event contract/ID generation as behavior, including repeated native polling and clock rollback timestamps.
Run green native tests, schema/static validation and Android build; record dependency choices/red-green evidence.
tasks.rollback: Remove unused Room callers/dependencies only before capture is enabled. Once records exist, preserve the database and use a data-preserving forward migration if an older reader is incompatible.

tasks.title: Record session lifecycle and blocked-app attempts
tasks.scope: Capture native session start/completion and distinct selected-app blocking attempts into Room through the event contract, with idempotent recovery/retry and no polling duplicates.
tasks.non_goals: No emergency/permission capture yet, fabricated historical completions, exposure of app content or per-poll analytics.
acceptance: Observed session start and completion produce one event each per identity/transition, including delayed recovery without claiming continuous prior observation.
Repeated overlay refreshes and duplicate accessibility events for the same entry do not inflate attempts; leaving/re-entering or a new launch produces a distinct observed attempt.
Event delivery survives reopen/retry without duplicates at the tested journal/Room boundaries.
History write failure is explicit and cannot permit a selected app or reset policy; bounded retry does not block the main looper.
Record no text/node content and no unsupported assertions about launch routes that were not observed.
test_plan: Write red native integration tests for entry/re-entry, duplicate events/polls, unknown foreground, start/end, late recovery and event-write/reopen failures.
Inject failure between authoritative transition/journal and Room insert/acknowledgment and prove retry idempotence.
Run green history/service/policy suites and record red/green evidence; verify small local record samples on device when available.
tasks.rollback: Disable producers/retry hooks together without deleting Room records or changing policy/identity. Preserve pending event intent for a later forward repair.

tasks.title: Record emergency and observable permission events
tasks.scope: Connect emergency request/completion and observable permission interruption/recovery events to local history, using native authoritative transitions and idempotent delivery.
tasks.non_goals: No reconstruction of unobservable downtime, JS event authority, new permissions or sensitive screen capture.
acceptance: Request and successful completion events reflect committed transitions once; duplicate commands/reopens do not create duplicate completions.
Cancellation can be distinguished from a completed grant; failed confirmation commits never produce a successful completion.
Reboot/session-end recovery and consumed-allowance behavior remain correct while delivery is interrupted/retried.
Observed disconnect/revocation/reconnection and current unavailable status are recorded honestly; unseen changes are labeled as observed later or unknown rather than invented exact timestamps.
History failure remains separate from authorization and is surfaced without changing emergency usage.
test_plan: Write red transition/history tests for request/cancel/re-request/confirm, duplicate taps, failed commits, Room failures, reopen, boot recovery and permission observation gaps.
Exercise event journal/Room failure boundaries and actual unavailable-status producer paths.
Run green emergency/history/service suites; record evidence and update observable-event documentation.
tasks.rollback: Disable added producers without deleting events or modifying used allowances. Retain original recovery and error reporting.

tasks.title: Display bounded local history
tasks.scope: Add native typed history reads and a minimal React Native history screen using bounded paging and clear event labels/times. Keep Room as local storage and preserve existing navigation.
tasks.non_goals: No charts, advanced analytics, cloud/export, retention/deletion controls or authorization based on history.
acceptance: Screen displays recorded sessions, blocked-app attempts, emergency requests/completions and permission interruptions with correct app/session/timing context.
Empty, loading, error, paging/end and retry states are explicit; no fabricated records or misleading continuous-observation claims.
Repeated requests/stale responses/unmount cannot reorder/duplicate visible rows or overwrite newer pages.
History remains available offline; bounded reads do not stall monitoring and failures do not change enforcement.
Event labels explain delayed observed completion or uncertain interruption timing when applicable.
test_plan: Write red native query/bridge tests and Jest screen tests for ordering/paging/empty/error/retry/stale/unmount behavior.
Run green JS/native history suites, typecheck and lint; manually inspect representative content and large enough paging fixture.
Record red/green evidence and no advanced analytics scope.
tasks.rollback: Remove history route/read APIs together while keeping stored records and event producers readable for a future compatible screen.

tasks.scope: Run broader scheduled/emergency/offline reliability checks on the exact supported device/build; reconcile deferred Phase 1 cases and classify support/limitations from observed evidence. Any code remediation requires its own test-first scoped subtask and recheck.

acceptance: Record actual attempts/successes/exposure for launcher, recents, notification and deep-link entry; start with 20 per available route and mark unavailable routes pending with reason.
Cover UI closure, native process termination, reboot, permission revocation/re-enable, Settings/unrelated apps, split-screen/pop-up, sleep/lock/deep sleep and manufacturer battery settings.
